_doc: The role each resource card plays (tools/exam_builder/resource_roles.py classify_resource_item, and resourceRoleOf in src/ui.tsx). Both are tested against this one table, so they cannot drift apart. Only STUDY_MATERIAL, LECTURE_VIDEO and PRACTICE_TOOL reach the Resource Library. Real cards are listed with the exam they come from; edge cases say what they pin. sectionForRole is the one placement model: where each role is shown on an exam's page (SECTION_FOR_ROLE in resource_roles.py, RESOURCE_SECTION in src/ui.tsx); null means never shown as a resource.
